title: Precision Vanilla
description: Precision Vanilla: Optimized Minecraft with smoother gameplay, better visuals, and subtle quality of life improvements, all without changing vanilla.
body:
# Precision Vanilla 
This is a **highly optimized** Minecraft modpack that keeps the **classic vanilla experience** intact while **boosting performance and gameplay**. It adds **smooth FPS** improvements, entity and world optimizations, and subtle **quality of life features** like inventory management, enhanced HUD, and better chat. **Visuals are refined** with shaders, animated models, improved clouds, and unique effects, while exploration and navigation are made easier with minimaps and world enhancements. Every mod is chosen to make Minecraft smoother, prettier, and more enjoyable **without changing the core gameplay**.
![PV Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ea2697898740e014a04858bec7a2b1bee71ec7f.jpeg)

## Optimization

Precision Vanilla is tuned for speed.
It includes proven optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, Krypton, Clumps, BadOptimizations, Entity Culling, etc,. delivering noticeably **higher FPS and faster load times** on almost any setup.
Everything is tested for stability, so you can enjoy **better performance without worrying about your potato jet engine taking off to mars**.

### FPS in high render distance
![High FPS in high render distance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6e080dbe09739677a6d2a2db81ecea7ed63a4c1_0.webp)

## Smart Quality of Life

Includes a few lightweight mods that remove small annoyances — AppleSkin, Mouse Tweaks, Debugify, Remove Reloading Screen, BetterF3, Xaero's Mini and World Map, Shulker Box tooltips, and similar tools that make playing a little easier without changing how you play.
**It’s still the same game, just with less friction.**

## Vanilla Experience, Just Better

This pack doesn’t add new blocks or features. It simply makes Minecraft feel more responsive and polished while keeping gameplay exactly the same.
This is achived with the help of Vanilla Tweaks, Continuity, Cherished Worlds, Gamma Utils (FullBright), Uniqe Dark, Zoomify, Health Indicators, Fresh Animations, etc,.
You’ll notice quicker menus, smoother animations, and a more consistent framerate across worlds.

## Compatibility

Precision Vanilla works with all vanilla and Fabric servers.
It doesn’t add content, so you can join worlds or servers that don’t use mods, and everything will still work fine.

## Updates

The pack will stay current with new Minecraft releases and Fabric versions.
Updating is simple, and your mod settings are kept whenever possible.

## Built on Fabric

Fabric is fast, minimal, and open — the perfect base for an optimized setup.
You can easily add your own mods on top of this pack if you want to customize it further.

## FAQ

> Q: Does this pack add new content?
> 
> A: No. It’s strictly focused on performance and usability.

> Q: Can I use it on servers?
> 
> A: Yes. It’s fully multiplayer-safe.

> Q: How do I install or update it?
> 
> A: Download it from Modrinth or any Fabric-compatible launcher.

> Q: Does it support shaders or OptiFine features?
> 
> A: Yes — through alternatives like Iris and Continuity.

> Q: Found a bug or have suggestions?
> 
> A: Report issues or ideas on our Modrinth

## Community

Precision Vanilla is a personal project built with the goal of keeping Minecraft smooth, fast, and clean.
Feedback is always welcome — if you spot something off or have a suggestion, let me know on the project page.
